<thought>Based on the spectrum, there is a clear M+2 peak (≈33 % of the base peak) which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a distinctive, unambiguous pattern (e.g., bromine’s ~1:1 M+2, sulfur’s ~4 % M+2). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
